interpretation_ko: 지속적인 질병과 불행한 상태를 나타내는 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign indicating continued sickness and unhappy states

cite.original: Seen in your dreams, they indicate continued sickness and unhappy states.

interpretation_ko: 죽음을 암시하는 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign intimating fatalities

cite.original: Fatalities are intimated if you see them in profusion.

interpretation_ko: 질병으로 인한 불행을 예고하는 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign foretelling unhappiness caused by illness

cite.original: To see bedbugs simulating death, foretells unhappiness caused by illness.

context: 빈대를 으깼는데 피 대신 물이 나옴
interpretation_ko: 놀랍지만 치명적이지는 않은 병이나 사고를 뜻하는 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign denoting alarming but not fatal illness or accident

cite.original: To mash them, and water appears instead of blood, denotes alarming but not fatal illness or accident.

context: 흰 벽을 기어오르는 빈대에 뜨거운 물을 끼얹음
interpretation_ko: 중병으로 괴로울 것이나 죽음에 대한 두려움은 쓸데없다는 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign that grave illness will distress you, but there will be useless fear of fatality

cite.original: To see bedbugs crawling up white walls, and you throw scalding water upon them, denotes grave illness will distress you, but there will be useless fear of fatality.

interpretation_ko: 치명적인 결과를 낳는 심각한 합병증이 있을 법한 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign that some serious complication with fatal results is not improbable

cite.original: If the water fails to destroy them, some serious complication with fatal results is not improbable.

interpretation_ko: 자신에게 권리가 있다고 여기는 어떤 사람이 비난하며 주변을 대체로 불쾌하게 만들 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign that some person who has claims upon you will censure and make your surroundings unpleasant generally

cite.original: To dream that you do not like your bed fellow, foretells that some person who has claims upon you, will censure and make your surroundings unpleasant generally.

interpretation_ko: 자신의 불만이 가까이 있는 모든 사람을 근심하게 만들 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign that your discontent will worry all who come near you

cite.original: If you have a strange bed fellow, your discontent will worry all who come near you.

interpretation_ko: 끝없는 불운이 드리울 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign that there will be unbounded ill luck overhanging you

cite.original: If you think you have any kind of animal in bed with you, there will be unbounded ill luck overhanging you.

interpretation_ko: 꿈꾼 이에게 행복한 변화가 있고, 먼 곳으로 여행하며 즐거운 동반자를 만날 조짐
interpretation_en: a happy change for the dreamer; journeys to distant places, and pleasant companions

cite.original: To see one newly furnished, a happy change for the dreamer. Journeys to distant places, and pleasant companions.

interpretation_ko: 악성 암과 종양이 생길 조짐이니 타박상이나 부상을 조심해야 한다
interpretation_en: a sign that cancers and tumors of a malignant nature will attack the subject; be on your guard as to bruises and hurts of any kind

cite.original: If raw and bloody, cancers and tumors of a malignant nature will attack the subject.  Be on your guard as to bruises and hurts of any kind.

interpretation_ko: 인간의 힘으로 감당 못할 고통이 닥치고 끔찍한 방식으로 목숨을 잃을 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign that anguish surpassing human aid is before you and loss of life by horrible means will occur

cite.original: To see, or eat cooked beef, anguish surpassing human aid is before you. Loss of life by horrible means will occur.

interpretation_ko: 사랑과 사업에서 조화로운 상태를 예고하는 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign denoting harmonious states in love and business

cite.original: Beef properly served under pleasing surroundings denotes harmonious states in love and business, if otherwise, evil is foreboded, though it may be of a trifling nature.

interpretation_ko: 사소하더라도 좋지 않은 일이 예고되는 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign that evil is foreboded, though it may be of a trifling nature

cite.original: Beef properly served under pleasing surroundings denotes harmonious states in love and business, if otherwise, evil is foreboded, though it may be of a trifling nature.

interpretation_ko: 실망을 예고하는 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign fateful of disappointments

cite.original: Fateful of disappointments if drinking from a bar.

context: 다른 사람이 맥주 마시는 것을 봄
interpretation_ko: 음모를 꾸미는 자들의 공작이 가장 큰 희망을 밀어낼 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign that the work of designing intriguers will displace your fairest hopes

cite.original: To see others drinking, work of designing intriguers will displace your fairest hopes.

context: 평소 맥주를 즐기는 사람이 꿈을 꿈
interpretation_ko: 유쾌하고 자연스럽고 깨끗한 조건이 유지되면 조화로운 전망이 예고되는 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign that harmonious prospects are foreshadowed, if pleasing, natural and cleanly conditions survive

cite.original: To habitue's of this beverage, harmonious prospectives are foreshadowed, if pleasing, natural and cleanly conditions survive.

interpretation_ko: 즐겁고 이로운 만남을 뜻하는 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign signifying pleasant and profitable engagements

cite.original: Bees signify pleasant and profitable engagements.

interpretation_ko: 순종하는 부하와 건강한 환경을 가져오는 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign that brings obedient subjects and healthful environments

cite.original: For an officer, it brings obedient subjects and healthful environments.

interpretation_ko: 새 신도가 많아지고 기도하는 회중이 생길 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign of many new members and a praying congregation

cite.original: To a preacher, many new members and a praying congregation.

interpretation_ko: 거래가 늘어날 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign of increase in trade

cite.original: To business men, increase in trade.

interpretation_ko: 효성스러운 자녀에게서 큰 기쁨을 누릴 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign of much pleasure from dutiful children

cite.original: To parents, much pleasure from dutiful children.

interpretation_ko: 친한 사람으로부터 손실이나 피해를 입을 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign that loss or injury will bear upon you from a friendly source

cite.original: If one stings, loss or injury will bear upon you from a friendly source.

interpretation_ko: 가난과 자잘한 병을 뜻하는 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign denoting poverty and small ills

cite.original: To dream of seeing them on your person, denotes poverty and small ills.

interpretation_ko: 좋은 조짐
interpretation_en: a good sign

cite.original: To kill them is good.

interpretation_ko: 그 땅에 풍작과 평화가 있을 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign that harvest and peace will obtain in the land

cite.original: To see them growing abundantly, harvest and peace will obtain in the land;

interpretation_ko: 좋은 소식으로 가득한 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign full of good tidings

cite.original: eating them with others, is full of good tidings.

context: 더럽거나 불결한 그릇에 담긴 사탕무를 봄
interpretation_ko: 괴로운 깨어남이 방해할 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign that distressful awakenings will disturb you

cite.original: If they are served in soiled or impure dishes, distressful awakenings will disturb you.

interpretation_ko: 관리 소홀의 조짐이며, 절약하지 않으면 재산을 많이 잃고 추문이 명성에 해가 될 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign of bad management, and unless you are economical you will lose much property; scandalous reports will prove detrimental to your fame

cite.original: To see an old, decrepit beggar, is a sign of bad management, and unless you are economical, you will lose much property. Scandalous reports will prove detrimental to your fame.

interpretation_ko: 현재 처지에 대한 불만을 뜻하는 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign denoting dissatisfaction with present surroundings

cite.original: To give to a beggar, denotes dissatisfaction with present surroundings.

interpretation_ko: 전반적으로 나쁜 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign that is altogether bad

cite.original: To dream that you refuse to give to a beggar is altogether bad.

interpretation_ko: 어떤 일에서 압도적인 패배나 실패가 곧 따를 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign that overwhelming defeat or failure in some undertaking will soon follow

cite.original: To dream of being beheaded, overwhelming defeat or failure in some undertaking will soon follow.

context: 피가 많이 흐르며 다른 사람이 참수당하는 것을 봄
interpretation_ko: 죽음과 추방을 예고하는 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign that death and exile are portended

cite.original: To see others beheaded, if accompanied by a large flow of blood, death and exile are portended.

interpretation_ko: 큰 손실과 가까운 친척의 이른 죽음을 나타내는 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign indicating disastrous losses and the early dissolution of a dear relative

cite.original: To see one, indicates disastrous losses and the early dissolution of a dear relative.

interpretation_ko: 불행한 결혼을 뜻하는 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign denoting an unfortunate marriage

cite.original: To see one, strewn with flowers in a church, denotes an unfortunate marriage.

interpretation_ko: 전략적인 움직임이 상업에서 성공을 가져올 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign that strategic moves will bring success in commercial circles

cite.original: Strategic moves will bring success in commercial circles.

interpretation_ko: 사교계에서 경쟁자를 만나고, 남성의 애정을 얻으려는 노력이 헛되고 성과 없을 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign that women will find rivals in society, and vain and fruitless efforts will be made for places in men's affections

cite.original: Women will find rivals in society; vain and fruitless efforts will be made for places in men's affections.

interpretation_ko: 불행과 과거 빚을 갚지 못할 조짐을 뜻함
interpretation_en: a sign denoting misery and failure to meet past debts

cite.original: Taking it, denotes misery and failure to meet past debts.

interpretation_ko: 행운이 다가오고, 중요한 문제가 분쟁 당사자들 사이에서 원만히 해결될 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign that fortune is hurrying after you, and questions of importance will be settled amicably among disputants

cite.original: Fortune is hurrying after you.  Questions of importance will be settled amicably among disputants.

interpretation_ko: 슬픈 일이나 불행이 곧 따를 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign that some sorrowful event or misfortune may soon follow

cite.original: To see him looking sad some sorrowful event or misfortune may soon follow.

interpretation_ko: 고난이 있으나 노력과 인내로 가난과 운명을 끝내 이겨낼 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign denoting a struggle, but a final triumph over poverty and fate by energy and perseverance

cite.original: Working a bellows, denotes a struggle, but a final triumph over poverty and fate by energy and perseverance.

interpretation_ko: 멀리 있는 친구들이 당신을 그리워하는 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign that distant friends are longing to see you

cite.original: To dream of seeing a bellows, distant friends are longing to see you.

interpretation_ko: 강력한 수단의 도움으로 신비한 지식을 얻을 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign that occult knowledge will be obtained by the help of powerful means

cite.original: To hear one, occult knowledge will be obtained by the help of powerful means.

interpretation_ko: 잘못된 충동으로 에너지를 낭비했음을 나타내는 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign portending you have wasted energies under misguiding impulses

cite.original: One fallen into disuse, portends you have wasted energies under misguiding impulses.

interpretation_ko: 멀리 있는 친구의 죽음이 있고 나쁜 소식이 근심하게 할 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign that death of distant friends will occur, and intelligence of wrong will worry you

cite.original: To hear bells tolling in your dreams, death of distant friends will occur, and intelligence of wrong will worry you.

interpretation_ko: 상대에 대한 기쁜 승리를 나타내는 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign indicating a joyous victory over an opponent

cite.original: Liberty bells, indicate a joyous victory over an opponent.

interpretation_ko: 심각한 질병을 나타내는 나쁜 조짐
interpretation_en: a bad sign indicating desperate sickness

cite.original: It is bad to dream of seeing a swollen mortifying belly, it indicates desperate sickness.

context: 배 위에서 무언가 움직이는 것을 봄
interpretation_ko: 굴욕과 고된 노동을 예고하는 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign prognosticating humiliation and hard labor

cite.original: To see anything moving on the belly, prognosticates humiliation and hard labor.

interpretation_ko: 미친 듯한 욕망을 뜻하는 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign denoting insane desires

cite.original: To see a healthy belly, denotes insane desires.

context: 최신 유행 벨트를 가진 꿈을 꿈
interpretation_ko: 곧 낯선 사람을 만나 약속을 하게 되고 그것이 번영을 해칠 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign that you are soon to meet and make engagements with a stranger, which will demoralize your prosperity

cite.original: To dream that you have a new style belt, denotes you are soon to meet and make engagements with a stranger, which will demoralize your prosperity.

interpretation_ko: 무례함으로 마땅히 비난받을 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign that you will be meritedly censured for rudeness

cite.original: If it is out of date, you will be meritedly censured for rudeness.

interpretation_ko: 채무자와 심복을 믿지 말라는 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign to distrust debtors and confidants

cite.original: Distrust debtors and confidants if you dream of sitting on one.

context: 다른 사람이 벤치에 앉는 것을 봄
interpretation_ko: 오해로 헤어졌던 친구들의 행복한 재회를 암시하는 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign suggesting happy reunions between friends who have been separated through misunderstandings

cite.original: If you see others doing so, happy reunions between friends who have been separated through misunderstandings are suggested.

interpretation_ko: 의무를 잘 수행했음을 알게 되는 데서 오는 위안의 기쁨과 젊은이의 건강이 보장되는 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign of pleasures of consolation from the knowledge of duties well performed, and the health of the young is assured

cite.original: After this dream, pleasures of consolation from the knowledge of duties well performed, and the health of the young is assured.

interpretation_ko: 계획이 빠르게 좌절되고 성공을 기대한 곳에서 실패할 것을 경고하는 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign warning that your plans will meet with quick frustration, and where you expect success there will be failure

cite.original: To dream of the bereavement of a child, warns you that your plans will meet with quick frustration, and where you expect success there will be failure.

interpretation_ko: 잘 무르익은 계획에서 실망하고 미래 전망이 나쁠 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign denoting disappointment in well matured plans and a poor outlook for the future

cite.original: Bereavement of relatives, or friends, denotes disappointment in well matured plans and a poor outlook for the future.

interpretation_ko: 새로운 일을 시작하는 것을 조심하라는 조짐이며, 적들이 정당한 사업에서 주의를 돌리려 함
interpretation_en: a sign to beware of engaging in new undertakings; enemies are trying to divert your attention from legitimate business

cite.original: Betting on races, beware of engaging in new undertakings. Enemies are trying to divert your attention from legitimate business.

context: 도박 테이블에서 돈을 거는 꿈을 꿈
interpretation_ko: 부도덕한 수법으로 돈을 빼앗길 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign denoting that immoral devices will be used to wring money from you

cite.original: Betting at gaming tables, denotes that immoral devices will be used to wring money from you.

interpretation_ko: 순수하고 사심 없는 즐거움이 주어질 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign foretelling that innocent and disillusioned enjoyment will be proffered for your acceptance

cite.original: To dream of the Bible, foretells that innocent and disillusioned enjoyment will be proffered for your acceptance.

interpretation_ko: 친구의 유혹적인 설득에 저항하던 유혹으로 굴복하려 함을 경고하는 조짐
interpretation_en: a sign forewarning that you are about to succumb to resisted temptations through the seductive persuasiveness of a friend

cite.original: To dream that you villify{sic} the teachings of the Bible, forewarns you that you are about to succumb to resisted temptations through the seductive persuasiveness of a friend.
